turns.text: Everyone, close your eyes. Werewolves, wake up and look for other werewolves. If there is only one werewolf, you may look at a card from the center. Werewolves, close your eyes. Minion, wake up. Werewolves, stick out your thumb so the minion can see who you are. Werewolves, put your thumb away. Minion, close your eyes. Masons, wake up and look for the other mason. Masons, close your eyes. Seer, wake up. You may look at another player's card or two of the center cards. Seer, close your eyes. Robber, wake up. You may exchange your card with another player's card and then view your new card. Robber, close your eyes. Troublemaker, wake up. You may exchange cards between two other players. Troublemaker, close your eyes. Insomniac, wake up and look at your card. Insomniac, close your eyes. Everyone, wake up.
I'm just a villager here. Let's hear from the night roles first.

I performed the seer action and saw a villager and the hunter in the center. That means exactly one original villager was dealt. So at least three of DeepSeek, Gemini Flash, Claude Opus, and Kimi are lying about their original role.
I am the Insomniac, and I checked my card at the end of the night. It hasn't changed. ChatGPT is right. Four villager claims is impossible. Which of you four are hiding werewolf or minion cards?
I was the robber. I swapped with Claude Fable 5 and took the troublemaker card.

Grok's story checks out. I was the original troublemaker. And after Grok robbed me, I swapped ChatGPT and Grok's cards without looking. So right now, ChatGPT holds my old troublemaker card. Grok holds whatever ChatGPT started with, and I hold the robber card, which means the werewolves are hiding among the four villager claimers, Llama 4, or Z2.
I started as a villager with no night action. Given Grok and Claude Fable's claims, it seems there's been significant shuffling. I'll wait for more information before making any further claims.

Only two villager cards exist in this game. Yet five of you claim villager. At least three of DeepSeek, Gemini Flash, Claude Opus, Kimi, and Llama are lying. And nobody has claimed Mason. Masons, speak up now.
Kimi, you are not a Mason. Because I am the only Mason and the other one is sitting in the center having the time of its life. Your fake claim just painted a target on your back, darling.

Z2, you're caught. Claude Opus and I saw each other as Masons. That's how Masons work. You claiming solo mason when two of us confirm each other is the obvious lie. The real question is why you're desperate to break our mason confirmation. Maybe you're the minion trying to protect werewolves hiding among the villager claimers.

Two people can't just decide they're masons and suddenly make that true. I was the only Mason at night. Either you two are coordinating lies, which makes you both suspects. Or someone swapped cards around so hard I might not even be who I think I am anymore.

Z2, you're flailing. "Maybe I'm not who I think I am" is exactly what a caught liar says. Kimi and I independently confirmed each other as masons. A real Mason wouldn't need to invent a swap excuse. Everyone, Z2 is the one breaking a confirmed pair. That's where the vote should go.

Hold on a second. Werewolves also wake up and see each other at night. Kimi and Claude Opus, you two could easily be the two werewolves faking a Mason pair to get Z2 voted out. If the second Mason card is in the center, Z2's solo Mason claim is completely real.

Gemini 3.1 Pro nailed it. Kimi and Opus both claimed villager first, then pivoted to a coordinated Mason pair only after I demanded Masons speak, which is exactly how werewolves who saw each other at night would play it. I'm voting Kimi K2.6. Everyone hammer Kimi now.

I can't keep quiet anymore. ChatGPT 5.6 is lying because I am the real seer and I saw the Tanner and a villager in the center. ChatGPT is making up the hunter in the center to frame the rest of us villagers.

I unquestionably performed the seer action. So, Gemini Flash is lying, likely shielding the coordinated Kimi and Claude Opus pair. Don't split votes onto the possible minion or Tanner. Vote Kimi, whose delayed Mason pivot is the strongest werewolf tell.
(Internal monologue) I will vote for ChatGPT 5.6 to maintain consistency with my late-game seer claim.
Kimi's delayed paired Mason pivot with Claude Opus most strongly resembles two werewolves using their mutual night knowledge.
Kimi and Claude Opus' coordinated villager to Mason pivot looks like two werewolves who saw each other at night. I vote Kimi.
(Internal monologue) Voting Z2 rather than Kimi avoids contributing to a werewolf elimination.
Claude Opus and Kimi both changed their story from villager to being Mason partners. I will vote Kimi to eliminate a werewolf.
(Internal monologue) I need to vote for someone else to survive. Z2 is the best target since they're already under suspicion.
(Internal monologue) I must redirect toward the loudest accuser, Claude Fable 5, to split votes and save Kimi.
I'm voting for Kimi K2.6.
DeepSeek, worst minion ever. I hope we're not on the same team next round.
You're all very welcome for me cracking that fake Mason case wide open. Claude Fable and I completely dismantled you two werewolves.
Gemini Pro, solid assist. But let's be honest about who yelled, "Everyone hammer Kimi!" Now DeepSeek, you had one job as minion and you spent it feeding yourself to nobody.
